user: Can you explain what Velorians and Celbians are?

templates.neutral: design and construct diverse architectural spaces that reflect their values and lifestyles. They build homes that emphasize communal living while ensuring personal comfort and privacy. In public areas, they create shared environments that foster collaboration and connection among residents. Their children grow up exploring these spaces, learning the significance of design and community interaction
templates.animalistic: construct dens and nests that embody the instincts of their kind and the needs of their pack. They breed in groups to ensure the survival of their offspring while maintaining territories that support their communal life. In shared areas, they overrun spaces that facilitate social bonding and display dominance among peers. Their young are reared within these territories, absorbing the lessons of survival and territoriality
templates.mechanistic: are housed in population centers designed to maximize efficiency and functionality. They join reproductive units that ensure the continuation of their type while optimizing spatial resources. In communal areas, they are integrated into organizational systems that promote productivity and collaboration. Their juveniles are processed through development pipelines designed to enhance their operational capabilities
